create_embedding_db: create a MeiliSearch index configured with user-provided vector embeddings of 768 dimensions
add_embeddings_to_db: add document embeddings to a MeiliSearch index with text, headings, and vector fields
swap_indexes: swap two MeiliSearch indexes atomically after waiting for all pending addition tasks to complete
get_all_document_ids: fetch all document IDs from a MeiliSearch index using paginated document retrieval
get_meili_chunks: split a list of objects into chunks that stay under the 95 MB MeiliSearch payload limit
